hero.headline: Here's what we build.
hero.description: We don't work off a fixed service list. We build software around how your business already works, starting with what's below.

story: We started by building things to fix our own problems, then took that to businesses. We built websites first, and clients who needed more asked for ways to track stock, work out pricing and send bills without doing it by hand. This page shows what we have actually built, and how we think about the next thing.
statement: We build software around how your business already works, so it runs with less typing, chasing and guesswork.

painPoints.title: If any of this sounds familiar, that's the kind of problem we solve.
items: You're juggling WhatsApp, Excel, and paper just to keep things running.
The same information gets typed into two or three different places.
Only one person knows how something works, and things stall when they're away.
Your website hasn't changed in years and doesn't look like your business today.
There's no single place to see what's happening across the business.
Something only works because someone remembers to follow up.

capabilities.name: Automating manual work
capabilities.description: If a task only happens because someone remembers to follow up (approvals, reminders, weekly reports), we can build something that does it instead.

capabilities.name: Anything else that runs your business
capabilities.description: If it's not listed above, tell us how you work. If it's still on paper or in a spreadsheet, there's a good chance we can build a better way.

process.title: Coordination
process.description: We sit with your team and see how the work moves today, from first order to dispatch.

process.title: Demo
process.description: You see a working version of your own process, with your products and your terms.

process.title: Trial
process.description: Your team uses it in real operations before you commit to anything.

process.title: Iterate
process.description: We adjust it based on what your team runs into, until it fits.

process.title: Stay connected
process.description: After launch we keep checking in, fixing issues and adding what's missing.

whyUs.title: We stay after launch
whyUs.description: We check in, fix issues and add what's missing for as long as you use it.

whyUs.title: One thing at a time
whyUs.description: We build the part that hurts most first, get it into daily use, then add the next.

whyUs.title: We start by listening
whyUs.description: Before we build anything, we see how you work today. Then a demo, a trial, and changes until it fits.

reach: Based in Gujarat, India. Working with businesses wherever they are.
manifesto: We design software around how your business already runs. Websites came first. Custom software, AI, IoT and Alu360 followed, one client's problem at a time. We stay in touch long after launch.
